name: Copilot CoWork: Becoming Frontier with Human-Agent Collaboration
description:

Join our live masterclass to learn how organizations can enable employees to work effectively with Microsoft Copilot and AI agents, transforming everyday tasks, workflows, collaboration, and decision-making through intelligent human-agent collaboration.

Learn how Microsoft Copilot can help your organization improve productivity, accelerate execution, and drive measurable business outcomes.
